question: Does exact post-vision replay remain valid and materially cheaper for a real public domain adapter that explicitly freezes visual modules?

update.target_contract: rank-32 LoRA on language model and custom_text_proj; adapter_config regex explicitly excludes visual modules

measurement.interpretation: Warm-storage build timing. The exact IR predates the domain adapter and is reused because processor, input embeddings, and vision weights are dependency-valid.

gates.adapter_load: all 504 decoder LoRA tensors and two projection tensors load with no missing or unexpected adapter tensors
gates.dependency_validity: zero adapter tensors target visual modules
gates.semantic_equivalence: raw and exact-IR Full endpoints have maximum absolute error <= 1e-6

claim_boundary: This validates build replay for a real Vietnamese domain adapter on a frozen system slice. It does not claim Vietnamese retrieval quality because the adapter's public training set has no untouched standard evaluation split.
